children: Indian government bonds could see mild gains in opening trades on Tuesday, tracking a decline in crude oil prices, but major moves are unlikely due to concerns over further interest rate hikes in India and the US.
The benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond (IN069436G=CC) yield is expected to move between 7.22% and 7.28%, according to a private-bank trader, after ending at 7.2528% on Tuesday.
"We could see another attempt to break 7.25% convincingly today, but with no major change in fundamentals, the task would not be an easy one," the trader said.
Oil prices are down this week, with the benchmark Brent crude contract hovering around $93 per barrel, a more than 20% correction from the highs it hit towards the end of October.
Oil prices eased on projections that the oil market could return to surplus in the fourth quarter amid signs of recovering shipments through the Strait of Hormuz.
Still, worries about continued tanker attacks in the Strait, after Iranian drones attacked a US military radar system in Bahrain on Tuesday, kept investors nervous.
Crude oil price trajectory is crucial for an import-dependent India, as it affects current account deficit pressures, the local currency, and inflation.

The market has been positioned for another Reserve Bank of India rate hike in early December, after India's retail inflation moved above the RBI's 6% upper tolerance threshold for the first time in two years.
The recent correction in oil prices has calmed fears of an outsized 50-basis-point move by the RBI.

Meanwhile, US Treasury yields consolidated, with the 10-year yield in the 5.10%-5.15% band, with markets fully pricing in a 25 bps rate hike by the Federal Reserve on December 9 after stronger-than-expected October inflation and hawkish comments from members.
Overnight index swap rates are also expected to consolidate after a recent decline.
On Tuesday, the one-year (INR1YMIBROIS=CC) rate ended at 6.47%, while the two-year rate (INR2YMIBROIS=CC) closed at 6.4550%. The liquid five-year (INR5YMIBROIS=CC) rate declined 7.5 bps to 6.5175%.
